basis: User replied "Go" to the post-smoke recommendations (docs/smoke-report.md, protocol v3 section).

replicates.note: Design revision: smoke showed 4 of 8 outcomes flipping between identical runs. Replicates are run in fresh sandboxes and sessions; the analysis must resample tasks with their full replicate vectors.

blocking_gates: durable controller storage (no smoke waiver for learning or final)
human review of intake receipts with effort hours (family-supply checkpoint)
full task curation: 80 tasks beyond the 8 smoke families, frozen partitions
replicate-aware schedule and analysis frozen before learning

budget.conflict: The design reserves the final allocation at its worst-case bound before learning (v1.1 section 11). With 3 final replicates that is $118 of model calls, which cannot fit under the $50 cap.

options.A_recommended: Raise the learning authorization ceiling to $280 (covers the worst case, including the $118 final protection). Expected spend stays about $12; the ceiling is a stop, not a target.
options.B: Keep $50 and protect the final at a multiple of observed cost (for example $25, about 5x the expected $5). If costs ran far above smoke rates, the final could end incomplete and would be reported as INCOMPLETE. This departs from worst-case protection.
options.C: Keep $50 and use 1 final replicate (120 final rollouts, $39 protection). This undoes the variance decision for the final comparison.

analysis_plan: docs/rl1-analysis-plan.md (provisional until the pool review is recorded)
partition: configs/partition-v1.json (provisional, outcome-blind, seed from the pool hash)
